### 1\. Can Indian students study Biomedical Engineering in Finland?

Yes. Indian students can apply to eligible Finnish universities offering English-taught Biomedical Engineering or related engineering programmes, provided they meet the academic, language, and programme-specific requirements.
### 2\. How long does a bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering take in Finland?
A bachelor’s degree commonly takes three years and includes 180 ECTS credits. Some universities offer integrated bachelor’s and master’s pathways that take approximately five years.
### 3\. Is Biomedical Engineering taught in English in Finland?
Yes. Selected universities offer English-taught Biomedical Engineering programmes or study tracks. Students should confirm the language of instruction for their chosen programme.
### 4\. What is the tuition fee for Biomedical Engineering in Finland?

Tuition fees vary by university and programme. For example, Tampere University lists €10,000 per year for its Biomedical Engineering bachelor’s pathway, approximately ₹10,50,000 per year at an indicative exchange rate of €1 \= ₹105.
### 5\. Can students work after completing Biomedical Engineering in Finland?

Graduates may explore employment opportunities in medical devices, healthcare technology, diagnostics, biomedical research, and engineering. Employment depends on qualifications, job availability, language skills, and applicable residence permit rules.
